## [US Visa Bulletin August 2026: A new uncertainty looms over Indians in the Green Card queue](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/nri/migrate/us-visa-bulletin-august-2026-a-new-uncertainty-looms-over-indians-in-the-green-card-queue/articleshow/132527973.cms)  
Indian professionals face continued delays for US employment-based green cards in August 2026. The EB-2 category remains unavailable, and EB-1 may soon be suspended due to high demand. Skilled workers in the EB-3 category also see no progress in their wait. Family-sponsored preference categories show mixed movement for Indian applicants. Understanding visa bulletin dates is crucial for navigating the green card process.
## [Quote of the Day by James Watt: “Great discoveries are seldom made by those who...” - Timeless life lessons on patience, hard work, quiet determination, endurance, innovation and why great success never comes overnight from the legendary steam engine innovator](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/international/us/quote-of-the-day-by-james-watt-great-discoveries-are-seldom-made-by-those-who-timeless-life-lessons-on-patience-hard-work-quiet-determination-endurance-innovation-and-why-great-success-never-comes-overnight-from-the-legendary-steam-engine-innovator/articleshow/132393769.cms)  
Quote of the Day by James Watt offers more than inspiration. It reveals the timeless mindset behind every lasting achievement. James Watt transformed the steam engine through years of careful improvement, helping power the Industrial Revolution and reshape modern industry. His famous words remind us that great discoveries grow from patience, hard work, curiosity, resilience, and quiet determination.

[Pays $120,000 a year, yet no takers: Inside the job Americans keep turning down](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/international/us/pays-120000-a-year-yet-no-takers-inside-the-job-americans-keep-turning-down/articleshow/126441712.cms)  
The U.S. has over one million unfilled skilled trade jobs. Ford alone struggles to fill 5,000 mechanic positions. Salaries reach $120,000 annually but applicants are scarce. Trades like plumbing, electrical work, and manufacturing face severe shortages. Training pipelines produce too few graduates. Retirements outpace new workers. The gap threatens infrastructure, manufacturing, and green energy growth nationwide.  
[AI taking away jobs? But, Ford CEO says America is in trouble as 5,000 mechanic jobs at $120,000 go unfilled](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/international/us/ai-taking-away-jobs-but-ford-ceo-says-america-is-in-trouble-as-5000-mechanic-jobs-at-120000-go-unfilled/articleshow/125465301.cms)  
Ford CEO Jim Farley highlights a critical shortage of skilled mechanics, with 5,000 high-paying jobs ($120K/year) unfilled. He attributes this to a lack of investment in trade education, warning it poses a national security risk. While college enrollment declines, trade schools are seeing a modest uptick, suggesting a potential shift in career aspirations.
